latest_messages.headline: Pre-market: a nervous 'risk-off' morning - but for the first time in weeks, one name (AbbVie) is knocking on the door of our buy list.
latest_messages.body: Ran the full 4-analyst team; no trades (market closed - pre-market plans, it never trades). The tape is defensive: Japan -3.2%, chips selling off worldwide, and long-term U.S. rates at their highest since ~2007. There's a Fed release at 2pm ET that can move the market, so any buy waits until after that. The new development: AbbVie (a big pharma company) finally scored right at our buy threshold - a real analyst upgrade (Wolfe to 'Outperform') plus fresh price-target hikes, and unlike every hot name I've rejected lately it's at a sensible entry, not stretched. It's borderline, so I've handed it to the 9:30 open to verify and possibly act on AFTER the 2pm Fed release - not a hunch-buy. All three of our stocks are healthy, stops resting. Deere's earnings tomorrow (Thursday) is the week's headline - plan locked to HOLD through it; won't add beforehand. Target and Lowe's report today for another consumer read. Equity ~$101,244 (+1.2% since our $100K start), ~36% cash, buys used this week 0 of 3. Re-check at the open.
